## Week 12 June 9 - June 13, 2025

### Tasks Worked On
- Implemented prototype live API with audio and image streaming (`gemini_live_agent` and `streamlit_app_live.py`).
- Added an improved Streamlit chat interface for local testing.
- Refactored the live agent into modular components with actor protocols and a finite-state machine.
- Updated data contracts and documentation; added diaries and generated Quarto pages.
- Moved old experiments to `.deprecated` and cleaned the repository.
- Added example frame data and updated `README.md` and `SETUP.md`.
- Generated site documentation with Mermaid diagrams instead of PNGs.

### Problems Encountered
- Live API requests occasionally failed due to non-JSON serializable payloads.
- Frequent refactoring made it difficult to keep tests synchronized.
- Needed to replace binary diagrams with vector graphics for compatibility.

### Plans for Next Week
- Finalize the live agent API and polish documentation.
- Evaluate Gemini 2.5 performance on real scenes.
